name: Red Hill South
intro: Red Hill South is a rural wine-country locality just beyond Red Hill village. Paringa Estate and Many Little both list Red Hill South addresses, giving visitors a cellar-door-and-lunch route with a clear local anchor. The roads are quieter than a shopping strip, so plan the places you want to visit before setting out. Red Hill village, Balnarring and Main Ridge add further options, but they are separate localities with travel time between them. Come for a slow meal, a tasting and the landscape rather than a packed checklist.
factualLede: Red Hill South is a rural locality on the Mornington Peninsula's wine-country plateau, with Paringa Estate and Many Little among its visitor destinations.

tldr: Red Hill South is a rural wine-country locality beyond Red Hill village, with local cellar doors and restaurants along its roads.
Best for: a measured cellar-door day, a long lunch and a rural stay.
Signature experience: a tasting at Paringa Estate and a pre-booked local lunch.
Allow a full day if you want time between stops; check current access and reservations.
Red Hill village and Balnarring widen the circuit but are separate localities.
notFor: first-time visitors who haven't seen Red Hill village
signature: A rural Red Hill South base for a measured cellar-door and lunch day.
skip: Assuming every winery takes walk-ins; check opening and tasting arrangements before the drive.
bestDay: Confirm a tasting at Paringa Estate, book a Red Hill South lunch, and leave time for the ridge roads between stops.
insiderNote: Check each cellar door and restaurant directly before travelling; neighbouring Red Hill and Balnarring are separate stops.
